scope: Every resolved base-game definition and registered UI asset. Character aliases, legacy sprite fallback and dormant roles are included. Declared routing is not a claim that every world scene was played.
rendererLimits: Terrain definitions include compatibility keys; terrain-art and map renderer apply authored state/season/crop overrides.
A creature may share a role portrait; these are not individualized gender/age portraits.
Animal artwork can exceed one tile while logical collision remains one cell.
